prompt:
Subject:
Graffiti wall and geometric dress

Main character:
A woman in her 20s leaning against a wall filled with pink, yellow, light blue, and black graffiti, looking straight ahead. Place largely in the center of the screen up to above the thighs, depicting a multicolored geometric pattern mini dress and a deep green jacket dropped from the shoulders.

Person/Expression:
Slightly long oval shape with a small chin, elongated brown eyes, thin gentle eyebrows, straight bridge of the nose, pale coral lips with thickness on both top and bottom. Face tilted slightly to the left of the screen looking at the camera, with a calm expression and lips slightly open. Black wet hair down to below the shoulders, center-leaning part, thin strands of hair sticking to the forehead and cheeks. Large golden hoop earrings.

Clothing/Pose:
A body-conforming mini dress with thin shoulder straps combining large curves and geometric surfaces in pink, blue-green, light blue, orange, yellow, white. Clear deep V-neckline and fine vertical wrinkles. A deep green thin jacket with white lining dropped from both shoulders and passed through the arms. Right hand placed in front of the waist, left hand placed on the left thigh, standing leaning against the wall.

Background/Light:
The entire background is an old white tile wall, with overlapping black lines, pink, yellow, blue-green large graffiti and paint drips. Apply soft bright light from the front top, illuminating the face and chest uniformly, creating a short shadow on the wall.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. Close-up portrait above the thighs with a front camera at eye level. Place the person largely in the center, capturing from the top of the head to the upper thigh, with both arms and the jacket at the left and right edges of the screen, and the thigh at the bottom edge. Sharp focus on both eyes and the dress, keeping the wall relatively clear.

Texture/Style:
Photoreal live-action photo in street fashion style. High-definition depiction of wet hair, skin luster, wrinkles in elastic fabric, nylon jacket, old tiles and thick paint.

Negative:
Significant changes to facial features and wet hair; simplification of multicolored geometric patterns
